shared_elements: low-relief carved figural/symbolic imagery on a stone surface
dense fields of small repeated signs or symbols
horizontal bands or registers of pattern
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow relief carving that combines a prominent circular disc with dense fields of small repeated signs and some human-like forms, but that is about as far as it goes. A shows a single monumental anthropomorphic block-figure with abstract emblems (disc, curved bands, hooked shapes) spread over its head and torso, whereas B shows a narrative scene of standing figures with raised arms flanking an offering table beneath a rayed disc, with framed registers of small glyphs — different subject matter, different relationships, and different compositional logic.
